sections.title: Common Inquiries
sections.subtitle: Details on insurance, scheduling, and our clinical approach.

items.question: Do you accept my dental insurance?
items.answer: We partner with most major PPO dental plans. Our administration team processes all claims and handles pre-authorizations on your behalf to maximize your coverage.

items.question: How quickly can I be seen for a dental emergency?
items.answer: We reserve dedicated clinical time each day exclusively for urgent cases. If you are experiencing acute pain, contact us immediately and we will prioritize a same-day evaluation.

items.question: What is included in a cosmetic consultation?
items.answer: A dedicated 45-minute session where we discuss your specific aesthetic goals, capture digital 3D scans, and map out a personalized timeline and treatment framework.

items.question: Are you currently accepting new patients?
items.answer: Yes. Your initial visit will consist of a comprehensive exam, a complete set of digital images, a professional cleaning, and a collaborative discussion about your long-term oral health plan.
